previous_statement: The associator axiom gives ||u^dagger bold-dot(u bold-dot h)-(u^dagger bold-dot u) bold-dot h||<=e||u||^2||h||<8*e. Left multiplication by h has norm at most (1+e)||h||<17/8, so this contributes less than 17*e; since u^dagger bold-dot u=J, the comparison endpoint is h bold-dot h. Together with node 1.4.1.1 the total is below 37*e<40*e.
new_statement: Let d=u^dagger bold-dot(u bold-dot h)-(u^dagger bold-dot u) bold-dot h. The associator axiom gives ||d||<=e||u||^2||h||<=8*e (for e=0 this says ||d||=0; for e>0 the final bound is strict). From the root smallness hypothesis, C_pol>=1 and kappa_pol<=1/2 give e<=1/2; and node 1.4.1 gives ||h||<=1+||h-J||<1+delta<=65/64. Hence the product-norm axiom gives ||h bold-dot d||<=(1+e)||h|| ||d||<=17*e, since (1+e)||h||<(3/2)*(65/64)<17/8. Finally u^dagger bold-dot u=J and exact unitality identify h bold-dot((u^dagger bold-dot u) bold-dot h)=h bold-dot h. Thus this node proves only the second comparison ||h bold-dot(u^dagger bold-dot(u bold-dot h))-h bold-dot h||<=17*e; its combination with the separate first comparison belongs to parent 1.4.1 after both children are validated.
